pageTitle: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn (Event)
name: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
description: The nation of Saurians beckons — an all-new odyssey is about to begin. New adventures, new encounters, and a vast world that keeps unfurling like a neverending scroll. Standing silently in the midst of that strange land, the Stadium of the Sacred Flame awaits the arrival of heroes...
